name: feat-2890-2d
title: #2890 round 2 — 2-D decides in its worker: the page answers while it computes (PR, port 5180)

cases.title: 2-D: while a slow line computes, the page still scrolls and answers clicks
cases.lookFor: Type the first two lines. Type the third and press Enter. While «הוסף» reads «חושב…» (about 5 seconds): scroll the page, and tick «הציגו מידות» off and on — each answers at once and the ring keeps turning. Then the third row lands, with the same note under the box as on prod.
cases.before: On prod the page is frozen for about 4 seconds of that line: a scroll or a click waits until it is over.

cases.title: 2-D: the defining interaction builds exactly as before
cases.lookFor: The square, G on AD, the 37° angle at B; three green rows.

cases.title: 2-D: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves the right angle
cases.lookFor: Each press moves the right angle to another vertex.

cases.title: 2-D: a contradicting length is still refused
cases.lookFor: The third line is refused: «… סותר את «AB = 5» …»; two rows.

cases.title: 2-D: deleting a row and «בטל»
cases.lookFor: The third row goes and comes back; three rows.

cases.title: 2-D: a row turned off and on again
cases.lookFor: Three rows at the end, D on BC with AD = 4.

cases.title: 2-D: editing a row in place
cases.lookFor: The third row now reads AD = 5 and the figure follows; three rows.

cases.title: 2-D: a figure comes back after a reload (a load)
cases.lookFor: After the reload and «המשך», the same three rows and figure.

cases.title: 2-D: swapping two letters, typed as a line
cases.lookFor: The rows now read with A and B exchanged (AB = 5 stays AB = 5 read the other way), the figure relabelled, no refusal.

cases.title: 2-D: a line the grammar does not read, answered by the model's stand-in, is still refused
cases.lookFor: The second line is not added: «לא הבנתי את הבקשה — נסו לנסח אחרת…» and the line stays in the box; one row.
